messages.author: c901bb3747660a9c
messages.subject: Several outputs
parts:
Hello,

if I perform some computationally intensive calculation and I would like to display the results with several outputs (e.g. 2 plots and one table). What would be the correct way of doing it?

My first thought was to use renderUI(), but it is my understanding now, that is is only for input. Will I need to build my own output?

Thanks for hints,

Johannes

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Several outputs
parts:
Hi - you can use a reactive expression to do the computationally expensive part, and then have renderPlot() and renderText() use the reactive expression. See here for more information:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#reactivity-overview
